pastorsIntroText:
The partner pastors of Prison Revival, on a weekly rotation basis, conduct the "Guided Prayer" which can be easily done behind bars, and the "Sunday Service Order and Sermon Files" to help inmates worship in their rooms.
They also answer "faith-related letters" from inmates, and lead the "Saturday Prayer Meeting" (conducted via Zoom).

pastorChoiOverlayText2: Prison Revival does not judge those behind bars as 'those whose flaws are exposed.' We spread the Gospel with the heart of the Lord, who loved them to the end (John 13:1).
pastorChoiOverlayText3: If you share love and the Gospel with Prison Revival, they will meet Jesus personally. And they will draw their life plan again and live a new life.

pastorBonghoOverlayText1: "The people living in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of the shadow of death a light has dawned." Matthew 4:16
pastorBonghoOverlayText2: I hope that the light that the Lord has shone upon me will now become a window that shines upon others.

pastorHeewonOverlayText1: If you want to experience the Lord who is still alive and active,
pastorHeewonOverlayText2: If you want to see up close that the power of the Gospel can still transform souls,

pastorSeungroOverlayText1: Jesus said that caring for those in the lowest and most marginalized places is caring for 'Me'.
pastorSeungroOverlayText2: Beyond simply helping the souls behind bars, we invite you to a place of grace to meet Jesus, who is weeping with the groaning souls there.

pastorGeumjuOverlayText3: Behind the walls, countless souls with 'poor spirits' are waiting to hear the Gospel and accept Jesus as their Savior.
pastorGeumjuOverlayText4: If there is anyone wondering how to repay the love and grace of God our Father who made us His children, please join the literature mission of Prison Revival.
pastorGeumjuOverlayText5: You will experience the joy of spreading the Gospel.

navSubPrisonAngelGuide: Prison Angel Tree Ministry & Support Guide
mannaSeumText:
There are children left home alone due to the sudden incarceration of their parents.

They are minor-headed households who, at an age when they should still be protected in their parents' arms, must cook for themselves, attend school, and worry about living expenses and their future. Although they pretend to be fine on the outside, loneliness, anxiety, and pain that cannot be easily shared with anyone reside in their hearts.

The Manna Bridge in Seum project is a ministry that delivers monthly growth support funds to these children so they do not give up on their dreams or lose hope due to economic difficulties, until their parents are released and return home.

By supporting each child with 80,000 to 100,000 KRW monthly, we help them buy necessary school supplies, have meals, and continue a normal daily life where they can hang out with friends. The amount itself may not be large, but to the children, it becomes proof of love that "someone remembers me" and gives them hope to dream of the future again.

We are not just delivering pocket money, but helping God's love and comfort flow into the lives of these wounded children. Your small sponsorship can protect a child's today and become a seed that changes their tomorrow.
mannaSeumHowText:
You can apply for regular sponsorship (automatic transfer) through the "Manna Bridge in Seum Regular Sponsorship" at the bottom, choosing any amount from 5,000 KRW to 300,000 KRW monthly.
Your regular sponsorship funds will be used as growth support for children living with difficulties in the absence of their parents, helping them grow healthy and prepare for their future.

For reference, tax-deductible receipts can be issued for Seum donations.
Changing a child's life does not start in a grand place. When someone's small interest and love come together, children gain the strength to live with hope again. We ask for your warm companionship.
mannaSeumBtn: Regular Sponsorship for Angel Tree Manna Bridge in Seum
mannaSeumDesc: A sisterhood ministry that provides continuous support for minors living in single-person households. Through regular sponsorship, we support the actual lives of children while serving as a conduit for God's love and the Gospel.
mannaAngelTitle: Manna Bridge in Angel Tree Project
mannaAngelText:
There are children left all alone in the world due to the sudden incarceration of their parents.

At an age when they should still be protected in their parents' arms, they are getting by day by day, eating meals alone without a guardian, going to and from school, and worrying about living expenses. Although they look normal on the outside, loneliness, anxiety, and wounds that cannot be easily shared with anyone reside in their hearts.

The Manna Bridge in Angel Tree project is a ministry that delivers love and hope to these minor-headed households by supporting them with necessary gifts, daily necessities, school supplies, and household items every month.

We are not just sending things, but wanting to convey the heart that "you are not alone" and "someone loves and supports you" to the children. A small gift becomes a great comfort to them and gives them the courage and hope to live again.

Your sponsorship filled with love cannot replace their parents' empty space, but it can become a conduit for God's love that warmly embraces that empty space.
mannaAngelHowText:
You can apply for regular sponsorship (automatic transfer) through the "Manna Bridge in Angel Tree Regular Sponsorship" at the bottom, choosing the amount you wish monthly.

The love that protects a child's today can change their tomorrow and become a hope that builds their future. We ask for your warm companionship.

progBookTitle: Book Ministry Delivering the Gospel Behind Walls
progBookDesc:
Prison Revival sends hundreds of Bibles and Christian books to inmates every month.

Many inmates did not have much opportunity to encounter churches or the Bible before their incarceration. Therefore, we provide the 'Duranno Woori Bible,' which even beginners can easily read and understand.

Furthermore, to ensure that those who encounter the gospel for the first time can read without burden, we also support books written by missionary Eun-Mi Lim, who has led many souls to the Lord.

Receiving books inside prisons requires a complex process of registering incoming books with the Ministry of Justice. However, through the dedicated service of our book dispatch team, we register and send each book with care, creating a conduit for the gospel.

Under God's grace, the necessary monthly finances are being filled, and hundreds of Bibles and Christian books are delivered to correctional institutions nationwide. Through these books, we continue to witness amazing things: souls in despair encountering the Word, meeting Jesus Christ personally, and discovering new hope in life.

A single Bible or Christian book can be a seed that changes someone's life and transforms eternity.

We would be grateful if you could pray for this precious ministry and partner with us in support and love.
progBookQuote:
“Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.” (Psalm 119:105)
Today, that light is reaching even behind the walls.

progJesusDesc:
Life behind bars is restricted in many ways. That is why one of the most frequent requests from those who meet Jesus in correctional facilities is a drawing of Jesus.

Those who read the Word, pray, and begin their life of faith want to keep an image of Jesus they can look at and meditate on. However, behind the walls, even such a small hope is often difficult to realize.

Thankfully, through President Janet Hyun's 'JESUS AGAIN' project, that hope has become a reality.

At Prison Revival, there is a New Letter Team that prints out the first letter in color and sends it to those who apply for meditation. Through their service, a postcard of Jesus' face containing the decision prayer is delivered to the inmates who apply for meditation for the first time.

This one small postcard becomes the first Gospel for some, the beginning of faith to return to Jesus for others, and a gift of hope to endure difficult times for yet others.

The JESUS AGAIN project is underway to spread the Gospel beyond Korea to the whole world, and the ministry is expanding so that more people can meet Jesus and experience His love.

We hope that a single drawing will become a channel to preach the Gospel to a soul, and a single prayer will become a seed to change a person's life.

We would be grateful if you could pray for and support this precious ministry so that it can continue to spread the light of the Gospel behind the walls and all over the world.
progJesusQuote: “A small drawing that leads back to Jesus, and God's love for a single soul.”
progJesusFooter: The JESUS AGAIN Project continues to preach the Gospel today.

introPageDesc: Prison Revival, we invite you to a journey of faith.
introMainText:
Prison Revival is a lay gospel organization aimed at spreading the Gospel to about 64,000 inmates in 57 correctional institutions nationwide.

Based on Missionary Eunmi Lim's daily meditations, we produce about 30 pages of christian contents, including 'Weekly Guided Prayers' and Sunday worship files created by associate pastors, and US Prison Alliance Bible study materials.

This materials are delivered by volunteers who directly pay the postage through the Internet Post Office every week.

Through this letters, we help inmates (inmates) meditate on God's Word on their own and experience life changes.

To date, a cumulative total of about 7,700 inmates have encountered the Gospel, and about 3,500 people receive meditations every week. In addition, about 480 volunteers are serving for this ministry. (As of April 24, 2026)
recommendationText:
If the Lord were living on this earth right now and working with us,
I believe He would accompany all the ministries of Prison Revival.

Blessings to all who walk along with our Lord in the Prison Revival & Angel Tree ministry!

Missionary Eunmi Lim
ceoGreeting: Prison Revival & Angel Tree CEO Greeting
ceoGreetingText:
Hello.
This is CEO Hyuk Oh serving Prison Revival & Angel Tree.
Our ministry started with the goal of preaching the Gospel to about 64,000 inmates in 57 correctional institutions nationwide, and bringing real change to their lives.
Although it is in an unseen place and an area that no one easily approaches, we believe it is the place where the Gospel is most desperately needed.
We are convinced that a letter and a meditation on the Word can change a person's life more than a grand program.
So even now, we steadily preach the Gospel every week through the dedication of each volunteer.
In addition, through the Angel Tree, we convey love to the children of parents behind bars, helping the next generation move toward the path of recovery rather than disconnection.
This ministry is not structured to be maintained by the dedication of a few, but definitely requires the participation of more people.
Many people are still waiting, and one person's participation leads to the transformation of a soul.
Please join us on this journey of faith.
Thank you.
advisorGreeting: Prison Revival & Angel Tree Advisor Greeting
advisorGreetingText:
Just as Jonah was sent to save Nineveh, the wicked city of Assyria,
I believe that God established and sent "Prison Revival"!
Imitating Jesus who followed God's will and love,
I bless you in the name of Jesus so that the brothers and sisters behind bars can receive more blessings by becoming volunteers who pray for them, preach the Gospel to even one more person, and let the brothers and sisters behind bars know God's love!
Amen 🙏

volProgDescMain: Someone is waiting for the Gospel you send. And we take on that mission together.
volProg1Desc:
The Prison Saturday Prayer Meeting is an online intercessory prayer meeting led weekly by Pastor Geumju Lim, Pastor Bongho Choi, and Pastor Joonmoon Choi.

Every Saturday evening, we gather through Zoom to pray with one heart for Prison Revival and Angel Tree ministries, the inmates, the associate pastors, and the volunteers who work together.

Prison ministry is a ministry that cannot be handled by human strength and passion alone. The transformation of a soul behind bars, the recovery of a wounded family, and the future of children living in the absence of parents are all possible only with God's grace and help. That is why we pray before we work, rely on God before we plan, and prepare the beginning and end of all ministries with prayer.

The Saturday Prayer Meeting is not just a meeting to share prayer titles. It is a time of grace to confirm that God is still working behind bars, to prepare weekly ministries spiritually, and to encourage and build each other up. It is also a place where we pray with tears for the lives, families, and new lives of inmates after release through intercessory prayer, anticipating God's work.

Any volunteer can freely participate, and it's okay if you are not good at praying. Just gathering and praying with the same heart is a precious partnership.

Through the Saturday Prayer Meeting, many people experience God's comfort and peace, and enjoy the joy of looking to God before their work. Every Saturday, please come to the place of prayer to intercede for the souls and families behind bars, and experience the amazing grace that the Lord pours out.
volProg2Desc:
The Prison Volunteer Personal Prayer Room is an online prayer community where volunteers daily share and pray together for the practical life issues and prayer topics.

While serving, there are times when difficulties feel greater than joy. Anyone carries a heavy burden in their life, such as family issues, health issues, economic difficulties, relationship with children, balance of work and ministry. However, God does not want us to bear that burden alone, but wants us to pray for each other and walk together in the faith community.

The Personal Prayer Room is not just a space to post prayer topics. It is a community of love where we share each other's pain, weep together, pray together, and experience God's comfort and recovery. It is a place where someone's prayer becomes my strength, and my prayer becomes a channel of recovery for someone else.

Specifically, Prison volunteers are those who serve and pray for inmates. However, those who serve also need prayer and comfort. Therefore, the Personal Prayer Room is becoming a precious prayer space that helps volunteers not get spiritually exhausted, gain strength again in God, and walk with faith partners.

Any Prison volunteer can participate, and it's okay if you are not good at praying. What's important is not perfect prayer, but a heart of love for each other. We invite you to a community where we pray together, build each other up, and experience God's grace together.

One person's sincere prayer can save a soul, recover a family, and change a person's life. Today, we pray for each other, anticipating the amazing recovery and grace that God will achieve.
volProg3Desc: Prison Revival Homeless Ministry goes beyond providing meals and daily necessities to homeless people, and serves to help recover their lives in the Gospel. Through regular meetings, we build trust and relationships, conveying love and comfort to those in loneliness and pain. In addition, through continuous care and spiritual support, we share the strength and hope to rise again. We believe that the transformation of one person leads to the recovery of another, and we dream of a Kingdom of God ministry where lives are changed by the Gospel and communities are built. We hope to become a channel of delivering love where the Lord's love is most needed.
volProg4Title: [ Alliance Bible Study for Prison Volunteers ]
volProg4Desc:
Prison Alliance Bible Study is a training course designed for Prison volunteers to be prepared with God's Word first, so that they can serve the ministry behind bars more deeply and healthily.

The ministry of delivering the Word to inmates goes beyond simply delivering materials; it is possible only when the person who delivers it first changes and is built in the Word. Therefore, Prison Revival values the time for volunteers to learn and meditate on the Word first, and know God's heart.

Alliance Bible Study is conducted in a way that shares the Word through Zoom, applies it to life, and encourages each other's faith. It is not just Bible study to accumulate knowledge, but a time to learn the living Word connected to actual life and ministry.

In particular, this course is also a preparation process for volunteers to experience and understand the Alliance Bible Study that will be provided to inmates in the future. Through this, volunteers will deeply understand the answer sheets and reviews sent by inmates, and will be established as prepared partners who can deliver sincere feedback and encouragement.

God's Word changes people, and one changed person becomes a channel to change another. We hope that you will change with the Word first through Alliance Bible Study, share that grace with the inmates, and participate in the life of recovery and discipleship that God is building.

We invite you to this journey of becoming one in the Word, connected in prayer, and growing together in the Gospel.
angelDescMain: Please join the Angel Tree ministry to help young children on behalf of parents behind bars.
angelIntroText:
Angel Tree is a ministry that delivers love and the Gospel to children of inmates on behalf of their parents behind bars.

The goal is to deliver gifts to children who suffer emotional and economic difficulties due to the absence of their parents, conveying the message "you are not forgotten" beyond simple support.

Specifically, the Angel Tree centering on Christmas plays a role in restoring family connection through gifts and letters delivered in the name of parents.

Also, currently, we are conducting 'Angel Tree Manna Bridge' ministry to continuously help minor-headed households.

It is an expanded ministry into a structure that supports the actual lives of children through regular sponsorship and at the same time preaches the Gospel.

As such, Angel Tree goes beyond one-time gifts and is becoming a channel of the Gospel that continuously restores a child's life and a family.

volGuideDescMain: Apply to be a Prison Revival Volunteer right now
volGuideIntroText:
Prison Revival Volunteer is a lay mission ministry that becomes the most practical channel to preach the Gospel to inmates.

Volunteers participate in the ministry by printing and mailing weekly meditation materials through the Internet Post Office, and directly bearing the postage costs. It is not a ministry that requires special skills or expertise, but it is a ministry that requires a sense of responsibility and dedication to steadily deliver the Word to a soul.

Many people behind bars cannot freely visit churches, and do not have many opportunities to encounter the Gospel. However, a letter sent by someone becomes a channel to deliver God's Word to them, and sometimes a gift that gives the strength and hope to live in despair.

In fact, countless inmates meet Jesus through weekly meditations, and experience comfort and recovery in the Word. Also, the stories of those who continue their life of faith even after release and start a new life continue to be delivered.

A Prison volunteer is not just a person who sends mail. They are partners who pray for a soul and preach the Gospel, and precious workers who participate in God's work of changing someone's life.

Currently, about 480 volunteers are participating in this ministry. However, to preach more Gospel to about 64,000 inmates in 57 correctional institutions nationwide, we need more partners.

Prison Revival is praying that 3,000 volunteers will be established together. Your small dedication can be the first opportunity for someone to meet the Gospel.

Someone is waiting for the Gospel you send.

ytLettersAngelTreeDesc:
💌 Angel Tree touching letters have newly started.
We record letters full of grace and love delivered through Angel Tree with a warm voice and share them through YouTube.
All letters contain the precious hearts of those who sent them, and the names are all safely protected and introduced as pseudonyms.
One letter becomes a lifelong comfort and hope to someone.
Listen to the stories of warm touch, and please show much interest and support so that love can be delivered to more families. ❤️

Please join the footsteps of Angel Tree that God has walked through the video now.
